verdicts.label: B
verdicts.evidence: The smallest loop enclosing a flooded diamond region of radius n has length 8n+4. Sun Wukong can build a loop of length gamma*n, so he can win for any gamma > 8 by choosing n large enough. For gamma <= 8, the flood's perimeter grows at a rate that prevents enclosure.
